about: Captured responses for the live-data provider tests. 'real' files are exactly what the source sent; 'reconstructed' files have the documented shape with invented values; 'derived' files were computed from a real response.

cdc-notices.xml.note: The CDC serves this with Content-Type text/html.

faa-airport-events.2026-11-27.json.note: No delays anywhere; HNL 'closed' to one military aircraft type, plus the LAX, LAS, SAN notices.

faa-airport-events.all-types.reconstruct.source: Field names from the FAA dashboard's own code and the real capture
faa-airport-events.all-types.reconstruct.note: Ground stop, ground delay, arrival delay, deicing and airportClosure values are invented: none was active when the captures were taken.

faa-airport-events.json.note: FLL and MIA departure delays; LAX, LAS, SAN general-aviation notices.

faa-airport-status-information.2026-11-2.note: Byte-exact. Closures list only; HNL appears twice.

faa-airport-status-information.all-types.source: Real capture plus the FAA DTD as quoted in public code
faa-airport-status-information.all-types.note: Ground delay, ground stop and airspace flow rows are invented.

faa-airport-status-information.no-delays.note: The shape with nothing active was not observed.

google-news-blocked-503.html.note: HTTP 503 text/html. Google News is not a source; this is only an example of a block page.

nager-error-unknown-country.json.note: HTTP 404. A real country with no data (IN) answers 204 with an empty body, in v3 and v4: there is nothing to save for that.

nager-v3-longweekend-us-2026.json.note: From the API version that ends 2027-01-31. Used only as the expected answer for the app's own long-weekend arithmetic.

npr-error-403.html.source: https://feeds.npr.org/1001/rss.xml requested with User-Agent 'trip-planner-dev' and no Accept header
npr-error-403.html.note: HTTP 403 text/html from the content network. The same address answered 200 a minute later to 'trip-planner/1.0' with an Accept header.

nws-alerts-point-active.json.note: Three alerts; geometry is null on all.

nws-error-no-user-agent.html.note: HTTP 403 text/html. Used throughout as a real HTML error page.

nws-error-point-out-of-bounds.json.note: HTTP 400 application/problem+json for a point outside the United States.

open-meteo-archive-error-daily-limit.jso.note: HTTP 429. The only real answer this host has given this machine.

open-meteo-archive.reconstructed.json.source: Shape per Open-Meteo's documentation (the archive answers like the forecast API)
open-meteo-archive.reconstructed.json.note: Invented values, in °F and inches. No real good answer from the archive host has been captured.

open-meteo-forecast-multi-location.json.note: The body is an array. The app never asks for two places; used to check that an array is refused.

open-meteo-forecast.json.source: https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast (Chicago, 14 daily + 7 hourly + 8 current variables, imperial units, timezone=auto, 16 days)
open-meteo-forecast.json.note: Untrimmed. The app asks for fewer variables; this capture has every daily one it reads, and every current one except cloud_cover.

state-advisories.index.derived.json.note: All 218 items reduced to name, level, the ISO code in the link, and the link. Not a provider response.

state-advisories.trimmed.xml.note: 20 of the 218 items, each copied whole: two per level plus the awkward cases.
